title: One Size Does Not Fit All: Distribution-Guided Tensor-Wise Adaptive Sparsification for Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2508.06163v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Merging multiple task-specific fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model provides an attractive alternative to joint multi-task training. To mitigate cross-task interference, a common strategy is to sparsify task vectors before aggregation. However, many widely used methods rely on a uniform global sparsity ratio, overlooking differences in pruning sensitivity across tasks and parameter tensors. Consequently, such uniform sparsification may remove useful parameter updates from sensitive tensors while retaining redundant updates in others. To address this limitation, we propose TADrop, a plug-and-play sparsifier that independently determines tensor-specific keep ratios from their magnitude distributions using a scale-invariant quantile ratio. TADrop operates in a data-free manner by default, while offering optional lightweight module-level calibration when a small validation set is available. Experiments across visio

translated_title: 千篇一律并不适用：面向模型合并的分布引导的张量级自适应稀疏化
translated_abstract: 将多个针对特定任务微调的模型检查点合并为单一的多任务模型，为联合多任务训练提供了一种颇具吸引力的替代方案。为了缓解跨任务干扰，一种常见策略是在聚合之前对任务向量进行稀疏化处理。然而，许多广泛使用的方法依赖于统一的全局稀疏率，忽视了不同任务和不同参数张量之间剪枝敏感性的差异。因此，这种统一的稀疏化可能会移除敏感张量中有用的参数更新，同时却在其他张量中保留冗余更新。为解决这一局限，我们提出了TADrop——一种即插即用的稀疏化方法，它利用尺度不变的分位数比率，根据各张量的幅值分布独立地确定每个张量专属的保留比率。TADrop默认以无数据的方式运行，同时当有小型验证集可用时，还可选择进行轻量级的模块级校准。在视觉等领域的实验中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TADrop，一种即插即用的模型合并稀疏化方法，通过尺度不变的分布分位数为每个参数张量自适应地确定保留比率，克服了统一全局稀疏率忽视张量间剪枝敏感性差异的缺陷。
en_tdlr: TADrop is a plug-and-play sparsifier for model merging that adaptively determines tensor-specific keep ratios from magnitude distributions via a scale-invariant quantile, overcoming the limitation of uniform global sparsity that ignores per-tensor pruning sensitivity differences.
